_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T3 strategic + compliance: Treasury / In-house Bank (IHB) / Cash Pooling. Declares nine new schemas (CashPool, CashPoolMembership, IntercompanyLoan, IntercompanyTransaction, FXContract, FXPosition, CashForecast, BankReconciliationGroup, LiquidityKPI) plus their lifecycles, aggregation formulas, RBAC and seed objects. Per ADR-031 all treasury calculation is declarative metadata; the only PHP seam is the period-close precondition guard for IntercompanyTransaction posting.

CashPool.title: Cash Pool
CashPool.description: Group cash-pool header. Type discriminator distinguishes notional pooling (interest calculated on aggregate, no cash movement) from physical zero-balance / target-balance sweeping. Master account, base currency, daily interest rate, interest-allocation method and minimum-cash policy drive the daily aggregation queries and the n8n sweep orchestration.

type.description: Pool type discriminator. Notional = interest only; zero-balance/target-balance = physical sweep.
type.title: Type

masterAccount.description: Master account IBAN that sweeps concentrate into.
masterAccount.title: Master Account

currency.description: Pool base currency, ISO 4217. Sweep + interest always post in this reporting currency for v1 (multi-currency deferred to T5).
currency.title: Currency

dailyInterestRate.description: Annualised pool interest rate used for daily notional accrual. Expressed as a fraction, e.g. 0.045 for 4.5% p.a.
dailyInterestRate.title: Daily Interest Rate

interestAllocationMethod.description: How notional interest is split across members.
interestAllocationMethod.title: Interest Allocation Method

allocationWeights.description: For weighted-average / fixed methods: map of administrationId → weight or fixed percentage. Ignored for proportional.
allocationWeights.title: Allocation Weights

sweepFrequency.description: Physical-sweep cadence. Ignored for notional pools.
sweepFrequency.title: Sweep Frequency

sweepTime.description: Local time the end-of-day sweep job runs, HH:MM 24h.
sweepTime.title: Sweep Time

minimumCashPolicy.description: Group minimum-cash floor in pool currency; the 13-week forecast raises a treasury alert when projected closing cash drops below this.
minimumCashPolicy.title: Minimum Cash Policy

effectiveFrom.description: First date the pool is active.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Last date the pool is active; null = open-ended.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

administrationId.description: Owning administration (the group/holding entity that operates the pool).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Treasury pool configurations retained 10 years per Dutch fiscal retention (AWR art. 52).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Pool is being configured; members and rules not yet finalised.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Pool is live; sweep and interest jobs operate against its members.

inactive.label: Inactief
inactive.description: Pool decommissioned; retained for audit but no longer swept.

activate.label: Activeren
activate.description: Group treasurer activates the pool after member + rule review.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Cash Pool is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CashPoolMembership.title: Cash Pool Membership
CashPoolMembership.description: Links one administration's bank account to a CashPool. Sweep direction, target balance, priority and intra-day limit drive the physical-sweep calculation; exclusions list accounts that must not be swept (e.g. regulatory-balance accounts).

sweepDirection.description: Sweep polarity. upstream = balance flows to master; downstream = funded from master; central = the master account itself.
sweepDirection.title: Sweep Direction

targetBalance.description: Target end-of-day balance for target-balance pools; null = zero-balance / notional.
targetBalance.title: Target Balance

priority.description: Sweep ordering; the master account uses priority 0.
priority.title: Priority

intraDayLimit.description: Maximum intra-day overdraft permitted on this account before a downstream funding sweep is triggered.
intraDayLimit.title: Intra Day Limit

exclusions.description: Account references excluded from automated sweeping (regulatory-balance / cash-management accounts).
exclusions.title: Exclusions

state.description: Membership state; suspended members are skipped by the sweep job.
state.title: State

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Cash Pool Membership is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IntercompanyLoan.title: Intercompany Loan
IntercompanyLoan.description: Inter-company loan between two administrations. Supports fixed and floating (reference rate + spread) interest, daily accrual and monthly GL posting on both lender and borrower ledgers. Transfer-pricing documentation reference (OECD arm's-length, Chapter X Financial Transactions) is stored for auditor review.

currency.description: Loan currency, ISO 4217 (v1: EUR; multi-currency deferred to T5).
currency.title: Currency

rateType.description: Whether the loan carries a fixed rate or a floating reference rate + spread.
rateType.title: Rate Type

fixedRate.description: Fixed annual rate as a fraction when rateType=fixed (e.g. 0.035 for 3.5%).
fixedRate.title: Fixed Rate

referenceRate.description: Floating reference rate index when rateType=floating.
referenceRate.title: Reference Rate

spread.description: Spread added to the reference rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.02 for +2.0%).
spread.title: Spread

transferPricingDocumentReference.description: docudesk URI to the OECD-compliant transfer-pricing memo.
transferPricingDocumentReference.title: Transfer Pricing Document Reference

administrationId.description: Owning administration (the group entity that administers the loan).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Intercompany loan agreements + TP documentation retained 10 years per AWR art. 52.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Loan terms being negotiated; not yet drawn.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Loan drawn; daily interest accrues and posts monthly.

written-off.label: Afgeboekt
written-off.description: Loan written off as uncollectible; terminal.

activate.label: Opnemen
activate.description: Treasurer draws the loan; requires arm's-length warning acknowledgement.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Intercompany Loan is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IntercompanyTransaction.title: Intercompany Transaction
IntercompanyTransaction.description: A single in-house-bank movement between two administrations: a sweep, loan drawdown, interest accrual or settlement. Posting materialises balanced double-sided GL entries on both ledgers; posting is blocked when either administration's period is closed.

poolId.description: FK to CashPool when the movement originates from a pool sweep/interest.
poolId.title: Pool ID

loanId.description: FK to IntercompanyLoan when the movement is a drawdown/interest/settlement on a loan.
loanId.title: Loan ID

amount.description: Movement amount in pool/loan currency (always non-negative; direction is given by from/to).
amount.title: Amount

postingDate.description: GL posting date; validated against both administrations' period status.
postingDate.title: Posting Date

valueDate.description: Cash value date (T+0 for same-day sweeps).
valueDate.title: Value Date

glTransactionId.description: FK to the materialised GLTransaction once posted.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

retention.description: Treasury movements retained 10 years per AWR art. 52.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Movement created (by sweep job or operator); not yet posted to GL.

posted.label: Geboekt
posted.description: Balanced double-sided JournalEntry materialised on both ledgers.

settled.label: Afgewikkeld
settled.description: Underlying cash transfer confirmed by the bank.

post.label: Boeken
post.description: Materialise GL entries; blocked if either administration's period is closed.

settle.label: Afwikkelen
settle.description: Bank confirms the underlying cash transfer.

FXContract.title: FX Contract
FXContract.description: Foreign-exchange contract with full IFRS 9 lifecycle. Records counterparty, instrument, buy/sell currency + amount, trade/value/settlement dates, contract rate, hedge designation and settlement instructions. Revalued at period close; unrealised gains/losses post to OCI or P&L per hedge designation (IFRS 9 §6.4).

contractRate.description: Agreed contract rate (buy currency per sell currency), three-decimal FX precision.
contractRate.title: Contract Rate

retention.description: FX contracts + confirmations retained 10 years per AWR art. 52.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a FX Contract is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

FXPosition.title: FX Position
FXPosition.description: Per-(entity, currency) open foreign-exchange position. Mark-to-market valuation and unrealised P&L are derived from the open position and the current spot rate; the consolidated group total is an aggregation across all entity positions per currency.

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency of the open position, ISO 4217.
foreignCurrency.title: Foreign Currency

position.description: Net open position in the foreign currency (positive = long, negative = short).
position.title: Position

spotRate.description: Spot rate (reporting currency per foreign currency unit) at last valuation, three-decimal FX precision.
spotRate.title: Spot Rate

fairValue.description: Fair value of the position in reporting currency (derived: position × spotRate).
fairValue.title: Fair Value

unrealisedPL.description: Unrealised gain/loss in reporting currency since entry (derived).
unrealisedPL.title: Unrealised Pl

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last revaluation; UI warns when stale > 1 hour.
lastUpdated.title: Last Updated

groupTotal.description: Consolidated group position per currency = sum of all entity positions and fair values.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a FX Position is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CashForecast.title: Cash Forecast
CashForecast.description: One weekly bucket of the rolling 13-week cashflow forecast for a pool/scenario. Inflows and outflows are aggregated from AR/AP ageing, payroll calendar and scheduled debt service; closing cash is derived; variance vs prior forecast drives treasury alerts.

forecastWeek.description: Week bucket index in the 13-week horizon.
forecastWeek.title: Forecast Week

weekStartDate.description: First date of the week bucket.
weekStartDate.title: Week Start Date

openingCash.description: Opening cash for the bucket (prior week closing).
openingCash.title: Opening Cash

arCollections.title: AR Collections
arCollections.description: The numeric value for ar collections.

loanDrawdowns.title: Loan Drawdowns
loanDrawdowns.description: The numeric value for loan drawdowns.

apPayments.title: AP Payments
apPayments.description: The numeric value for ap payments.

taxPayments.title: Tax Payments
taxPayments.description: The numeric value for tax payments.

debtService.title: Debt Service
debtService.description: The numeric value for debt service.

closingCash.description: Derived: openingCash + Σ inflows − Σ outflows.
closingCash.title: Closing Cash

varianceVsPriorForecast.description: Closing-cash delta vs the prior forecast run for the same week; alert raised when |variance| > EUR 50K.
varianceVsPriorForecast.title: Variance Vs Prior Forecast

lastRegenerated.description: Timestamp of the nightly regeneration that produced this bucket.
lastRegenerated.title: Last Regenerated

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Cash Forecast is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

BankReconciliationGroup.title: Bank Reconciliation Group
BankReconciliationGroup.description: A multi-administration bank-reconciliation run across all participants of a pool. Links one bank line to GL entries from several administrations in a single workflow (typical for shared-service-centre payments), with an auto-match score and an exception queue for operator review.

poolId.description: FK to CashPool whose members are reconciled together.
poolId.title: Pool ID

bankReconciliationId.description: FK to the underlying single-administration reconciliation master record, if any.
bankReconciliationId.title: Bank Reconciliation ID

participatingAdministrationIds.description: Administrations whose ledgers are searched for matches.
participatingAdministrationIds.title: Participating Administration Ids

autoMatchedCount.description: Number of bank lines auto-matched at score >= 95%.
autoMatchedCount.title: Auto Matched Count

manualMatchesRequired.description: Number of lines needing operator review.
manualMatchesRequired.title: Manual Matches Required

exceptionQueue.description: Lines below the auto-match threshold with suggested candidates.

bankLineId.title: Bank Line ID
bankLineId.description: The identifier of the associated bank line.

suggestedMatches.title: Suggested Matches
suggestedMatches.description: A list of suggested matches entries.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: The date and time for operator.

exceptionQueue.title: Exception Queue

retention.description: Reconciliation runs retained 7 years per AWR art. 52.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Run created; member bank lines loaded.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Bank Reconciliation Group is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

LiquidityKPI.title: Liquidity KPI
LiquidityKPI.description: Liquidity key-performance-indicator snapshot per pool + measurement date: cash-conversion cycle, days cash on hand, current ratio, quick ratio, with a per-entity breakdown and trend vs prior week. Computed from CashForecast plus AR/AP ageing.

daysCashOnHandDays.description: Closing cash / daily operating expense, in days.
daysCashOnHandDays.title: Days Cash On Hand Days

forecastRunwayWeeks.description: Weeks of cash remaining at current burn rate.
forecastRunwayWeeks.title: Forecast Runway Weeks

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The date and time for administration id.

daysCashOnHandDays.title: Days Cash On Hand Days
daysCashOnHandDays.description: The numeric value for days cash on hand days.

currentRatio.title: Current Ratio
currentRatio.description: The numeric value for current ratio.

quickRatio.title: Quick Ratio
quickRatio.description: The numeric value for quick ratio.

trendVsPriorWeek.description: Delta of each KPI vs the prior week's snapshot.
trendVsPriorWeek.title: Trend Vs Prior Week

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Liquidity KPI is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
